scope: Independent research cycle: exactly one input-only TRAIN101_479/ver; root alone releases actual CUDA execution

recipe.query_selection: first512 original nodes in canonical order
recipe.output_reduction: official half_cos of cached squared distance followed by sum

backend_parity.scope: two real CSR subblocks; original IntegralTransform with original Python CSR reducer versus GPU segment_reduce, compare values and source-feature/kernel-parameter gradients

adapter.official_unchanged: Positional embeddings, kernel MLPs, IntegralTransform multiplication/half_cos, FNO/lifting/projection
adapter.changed_runtime: Cached complete CSR replaces NeighborSearch; private IntegralTransform.segment_csr uses torch.segment_reduce; no dense cdist, scatter/Open3D dependency or silent fallback
adapter.input_checkpoint: Query chunks2048, use_reentrant=False; complete neighbor sets, shared source features and official parameter gradients retained
adapter.case_state: Full latent tensor plus fixed geometry/CSR; query API accepts canonical node IDs or separately supplied valid radius CSR for new coordinates
adapter.global_context: Existing xyz-only PointNet1024/global32 is live and broadcast to every latent voxel

access.allowed_radius_members: Exactly the eight NPY entries of the frozen completed radius inventory
access.author_execution: one AST/stdlib metadata source-check only; no toy/scientific imports/arrays/model/GPU
access.actual_execution: one root-coordinator CUDA resource job after source review; no package install or clone inside runner

outputs.summary: completed/feasible + config.contract + API/checks/actual costs/allocator peaks/input-only receipt
outputs.status: status.json; completed reuse checks metadata contract, no new arrays or GPU
outputs.parameter_count: actual public named trainable parameters, including complex parameters as numel; never inferred model-memory claims

limitations: Acceptance covers full one-CAD input encode and512 outputs with one target-independent backward, not fullN-output training feasibility.
Small-real-CSR reducer parity is a backend semantic check, not accuracy, continuous-query or engineering acceptance.
Input empirical mean/output mollified sum are not FEM volume integration, stiffness, hard boundary enforcement or PDE guarantees.
Measured peak covers this bounded task and its parity checks; future per-CAD/whole-dataset costs are unknown.
No labels/scaler/checkpoints or validation/final/dia inputs are read. The already-used final split cannot be reused to tune this new research cycle.
